# anyscale_user_groups (Data Source)

~> **Alpha.** User groups are an Alpha feature. The Anyscale API and this provider's schema for them may change drastically before Beta, including breaking changes in a minor release. See the [RBAC guide](../guides/rbac.md#user-groups-alpha).

Lists the user groups in the token's organization. Use `anyscale_user_group` for a group's members and organization role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Alpha: the schema may change before Beta.
# List every user group in the organization.
data "anyscale_user_groups" "all" {}

output "user_group_names" {
  description = "Names of all user groups in the organization"
  value       = [for g in data.anyscale_user_groups.all.groups : g.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `source` (String) Return only groups with this source: `user` or `scim`. Groups whose source is null match neither.

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Attributes List) The matching groups, most recently created first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The user group ID (`ug_...`).
- `name` (String) The group name.
- `source` (String) `user`, `scim`, or null for groups created before Anyscale recorded this.
